questions.question_text: A virtual network must route all internet-bound traffic through a network virtual appliance. Which configuration is required?

question_data.scenario: The appliance has a private IP address. Subnets in the virtual network must send 0.0.0.0/0 to the appliance.
question_data.instructions: Read the scenario, then select the best answer.

options.label: A
options.text: A user-defined route with next hop set to the virtual appliance

options.label: D
options.text: A public IP on each VM

questions.explanation: A UDR overrides the system default route and can point 0.0.0.0/0 to a network virtual appliance.
